message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays that occur in Canada during 2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a weekday and therefore gives you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Monday | Feb 18–20 | Observed in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island. |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | Apr 7–9 | Federal holiday; creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | May 20–22 | Federal holiday; creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | Sep 2–4 | Federal holiday; creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | Oct 7–9 | Federal holiday; creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Monday | Nov 9–11 | Federal holiday; creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | Dec 23–25 | Federal holiday; creates a 3‑day weekend. |

### Holidays that fall on a weekend (no extra day off)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Effect |
|-------------|---------|-------------|--------|
| Jan 1 | New Year’s Day | Sunday | Already a weekend. |
| Jul 1 | Canada Day | Saturday | Already a weekend. |
| Dec 26 | Boxing Day | Tuesday | Not part of a long weekend. |

> **Pro‑provincial variations**  
> Some provinces have additional holidays that can create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.). If you need the full provincial list, let me know which province(s) you’re interested in.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app!
